test_title: PYST 27: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the pair that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

MGP : NIS

SVB : TXE
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**MGP : NIS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45f0475c91c5eb600c8d22f8fa302500d49bc99b100b2b7d445b9ab353c5ec9a.png] 

**SVB : TXE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/108aeb8cc1d55994226ff94f55d04b1169c9f1d999e8eee787105c93a58073da.png] 

 

**Option 1: CDP : DUV**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19dd9e5d7d64aec08145616c18907adffb87609c9ccc511974365ba12345764a.png] 

This does not follow the pattern.

**Option 2: DMR : CMP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de86b939ab22405471caf56d7b3d1964b2776a6078938a84ced85c1c115acead.png] 

This does not follow the pattern.

**Option 3: DNP : CPT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1d18e57407eea3043f0da4a495aad12bd179be57d3f9a4327ed2ff6aa056753.png] 

This does not follow the pattern.

**Option 4: CTR : DVU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a12e12a9a3ef203f3e3f2e5e7c68499fc54518e3b94cc58cfec514263bb5e1d.png] 

This option **correctly follows** the pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
